name: ENS5v2 — 17:45-18:00 reversal, S10c rules
spec: Each day at 18:00, five factor models explain every stock's 17:45-18:00 return; the unexplained part (residual) is ranked and averaged. Long the 3 biggest unusual drops in the closing auction (sell at the next opening auction); short the 3 biggest unusual rises at the next opening auction (cover at its closing auction). Short skipped when the market's overnight gap is unusually large. 5 bp per side. S10c adds: A3 - whole long leg in the top pick when the 3 long signals are unusually close; B4 - hold longs through the next day when their signals are unusually strong; halve the short after a 5-day long momentum streak.
deviations: Inputs from Yahoo + Is Yatirim only: USD/TRY from Yahoo (original: central-bank EVDS), risk-free rate 0 (original: EVDS policy rate).
Sessions before 2026-10-13 were built from Yahoo 5-minute bars; later sessions from 1-minute bars.
backtest_note: Backtest over Yahoo's 60-day 5-minute window, computed with the original pipeline.
